what: Opt-in overlapped-speech separation (separate_overlaps) with VoxLock int8 (sherpa-onnx 2.0.1), compared with the same request without it (diarization + transcription of each turn from the mixture).
hardware: 4 vCPU x86_64 (Intel Xeon @ 2.10GHz), no GPU; shared with other jobs (load average 4-7 during the runs), so times are pessimistic

synthetic_set.how: Two-voice mixes made with bolo's own voices (12 English pairs: Kokoro and Piper amy; cross-gender, same-gender female, same-gender male; 1 Hindi pair: Kokoro hf_alpha + hm_omega). Layout: A alone, B alone, A long sentence with B's long sentence starting before A finishes (overlap 1, 2.5 or 5 s), then A alone. Levels: B relative to A at 0 dB for every overlap, and -5 / +5 dB at 2.5 s (5 mixes per pair). Telephony copy of every mix: 300-3400 Hz, 8 kHz, G.711 mu-law (sent with separation_allow_narrowband=true).
synthetic_set.metrics: cpWER: concatenated minimum-permutation WER over the whole mix (implemented here, same definition as MeetEval's cpWER). ov: per-speaker WER on the two utterances involved in the overlap; solo: on the three utterances without overlap. Recogniser words are placed evenly over their segment (no word times from whisper-base in sherpa-onnx) and counted in the region they fall in. Text normalisation: lower case, punctuation and symbols removed (Unicode categories P and S). Paired bootstrap over mixes (5000 resamples) for the 95 % interval of the relative cpWER gain.

ami.how: AMI Meeting Corpus (CC BY 4.0), single distant microphone (Array1-01), official test-split meetings ES2004a, IS1009a, TS3003a, EN2002a; 6 excerpts of 45 s per meeting with the most overlapped speech (from the manual segment annotations; 12-65 % overlap, so far more than a typical meeting). Reference: manual word transcripts. Overlap words: reference words within an annotated overlap +-0.5 s.

blind_sepformer_via_plugin.how: sepformer-whamr16k (SpeechBrain, Apache-2.0 weights trained on WHAMR!, i.e. WSJ0-derived) run by the bolo-torch plugin (CPU PyTorch) as a blind separator; bolo assigns its two tracks to the diarized speakers (voice similarity in the overlap + share of each speaker's solo energy). English pairs, 0 dB, overlaps 1/2.5/5 s (36 mixes, the same audio as the VoxLock rows with level 0 dB). The Hindi pair was not run (the plugin venv had no faster-whisper). Baseline taken from the main run (identical audio and recogniser).

pixit_via_plugin: not run here (2.6 GB download, disk); measured by the bolo-torch builder, see plugins/bolo-torch

ablation.how: 12 English pairs, 2.5 s overlap, 0 dB, a different set of sentences from the main run (so the baseline is its own run, tag ctx2). Tags: ctx0/ctx1/ctx2/ctx4 = separation_context_s; sample3 = separation_sample_max_s 3 (context 2).

assignment_check: Blind-mode track assignment with perfect tracks returned in swapped order (oracle separator, real eres2net embeddings, real diarization, Kokoro pairs 0, 9, 12): each diarized speaker received its own source (SI-SDR > 110 dB against it, < -24 dB against the other); pair 6 had no detected overlap.
